function.arguments: {"finding": "The raw difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search) is 0.0745, but this is confounded by customer segment. Therefore, the raw difference does not measure the campaign effect — it measures the difference in baseline conversion rates between customer segments.", "implication": "The raw difference is not a valid estimate of the campaign effect.
